goal: Build a Python CLI tool that calculates freelancer profit by tracking income, expenses, and taxes, helping freelancers understand their true net earnings and plan for tax season.
acceptance_criteria: CLI accepts income and expense entries via CSV input or interactive prompts.
Calculates net profit by subtracting total expenses from total income.
Applies a configurable tax rate (default 25%) and displays estimated tax liability.
Outputs a formatted summary report to stdout and optionally saves a CSV/JSON report.
